summary: Homeowner mailing address management (Ed 2026-10-27). Adds unit, country and provenance columns to contacts; a permanent history of staff mailing-address changes and of blocked import overwrites; flags for unmailed letters generated before an address change (with a mail hold on violation letters); a contacts trigger that stops imports/syncs from replacing a staff-entered address and keeps the one-line and structured mailing fields in agreement; the staff write function set_contact_mailing_address() and resolve_mailing_address_letter_review(); and four columns appended to v_current_property_owners. No existing address, property, ownership, letter or notice row changes.

preflight.name: the tables 549 builds on exist (contacts, properties, property_ownerships, interactions, letter_mail_holds, letter_mailing_evidence, collection_notices, audit_events, user_profiles)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('contacts', 'properties', 'property_ownerships', 'interactions', 'letter_mail_holds', 'letter_mailing_evidence', 'collection_notices', 'audit_events', 'user_profiles', 'ownership_tenures')

preflight.name: contacts has the 153 structured mailing columns and not yet the 549 ones
preflight.sql: SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE column_name IN ('mailing_address', 'mailing_street', 'mailing_city', 'mailing_state', 'mailing_zip')))::int * 10 + (count(*) FILTER (WHERE column_name IN ('mailing_unit', 'mailing_country', 'mailing_address_source', 'mailing_address_updated_at', 'mailing_address_updated_by')))::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'contacts'

preflight.name: v_current_property_owners has the 27 columns migration 457 defined, ending in tenure_id
preflight.sql: SELECT (count(*))::int * 10 + (max(ordinal_position) FILTER (WHERE column_name = 'tenure_id') = 27)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'v_current_property_owners'

preflight.name: interactions has the letter columns the flagging reads
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'interactions' AND column_name IN ('contact_id', 'property_id', 'community_id', 'status', 'delivery_method', 'printed_at', 'mailed_at')

preflight.name: no trigger already guards contacts mailing writes
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid WHERE c.relname = 'contacts' AND t.tgname = 'trg_contacts_mailing_address_guard'

expected_changes: contacts: 5 columns added (mailing_unit, mailing_country, mailing_address_source, mailing_address_updated_at, mailing_address_updated_by) + CHECK; BEFORE INSERT/UPDATE trigger trg_contacts_mailing_address_guard.
New tables contact_mailing_address_changes (append-only) and mailing_address_letter_reviews (only the resolution may be recorded, once), both association_record with a community FK.

New functions: mailing_address_compose, mailing_address_json, contacts_mailing_address_guard, contact_mailing_address_changes_append_only, mailing_address_letter_reviews_guard, set_contact_mailing_address (service_role only), resolve_mailing_address_letter_review (service_role only).
v_current_property_owners: same 27 columns in the same order, plus owner_mailing_unit, owner_mailing_country, owner_mailing_source, owner_mailing_updated_at appended.
No row changes in any existing table.
